newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in the panhandle area on Monday, USDA said. Not enough slaughter steers and heifers confirmed for a market test.

Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 900 head slaughter steers; 25,600 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 22,400 formulated and 700 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs $65.00.
Confirmed: 900 Week Ago: 1,500 Year Ago: None
Wk to Date: 25,600 Week Ago: 26,000 Year Ago: None
